text:
Alice: Heads-up — we saw a ~3x spike in token generation on hosted-api starting ~03:00 UTC. Cost alert fired and stakeholders asked for a short mitigation + instrumentation plan. @Ben @Carla :eyes:

Ben: On it. Which metric/graph should I look at?

Alice: datadog link: https://dd.example.com/dashboards/abc123 (token-gen, per-tenant breakdown).

Carla: I can own the token-attribution ingest cleanup (dedupe + schema mapping). Ben, can you review mapping PR when I post?

Ben: Yep. FYI schema rename will be breaking — need to coordinate with embeddings/consumers. @Samir any downstream tolerance for renames?

Samir: Embeddings team: we tolerate additive optional fields (ok) but not renames. If you add `token_origin` as optional string it's fine. Also noticed KV cache p95 jumped (20ms -> 90ms) which increased downstream latency.

Maya: I'll add a smoke test in the eval harness that hits the dedup path. Suggest canary 1% traffic. Config stub for the canary plan: 
```
route.canary: 0.01
pipeline.dedup.enabled: true
batch.max_tokens: 4096
```

Alice: Quick ownership call: eng-platform owns ingest & token attribution; eng-ml vets event schema; embeddings/consumers own client compatibility. If no objections I'll open a short RFC for event-schema v2 with migration steps.

Carla: +1 from me.

Ben: pinging @infra-bot for a capacity check on the dedup workers and an ETA for the canary deploy.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: infra/dedup-worker v1.3 -> canary us-west-2. ETA ~10m. Monitoring hooks enabled. :robot_face:

Carla: CR queue — please review these PRs when you have a moment: #1245 (mapping changes), #1248 (latency logging), #1250 (add `token_origin` field). Tagging likely owners.

Ben: Reviewed #1248, left one minor comment about log level for backpressure. Will do #1245 next.

Samir: I'll review #1250 tonight. Can we include a compatibility fallback: retain top-level `token` if `token.v2` is missing? That avoids a hot fix in consumers.

Alice: Good idea — please include fallback in PR. Also request: someone post p95/p99 latency diffs for routing tier for the last 6 hours; I need numbers for the 16:00 stakeholder update.

Maya: grabbing metrics now, will post shortly.

Maya: Quick numbers: p95 today 48ms (baseline 22ms), p99 210ms (baseline 105ms). Correlates with higher KV miss rate and larger effective batch sizes after the traffic spike.

Alice: Thanks. Action plan for immediate mitigation: 1) 1% canary to dedup-enabled pipeline (Maya + infra-bot), 2) Merge CRs for mapping + latency-logging + schema fallback (Carla/Ben/Samir), 3) Run smoke tests and monitor p95/p99 for 30m, 4) Roll forward only if metrics back to within 1.5x baseline or cost delta <2x.

Carla: I won't roll full until PRs merged and Samir signs off on schema.

Ben: I'll finish code review in ~45m.

Samir: Also adding a doc change request — update event-schema.md to list `token_origin` as optional string and include the fallback example. I'll approve after that update.

Alice: Closing loop — owners checklist: @Carla (mapping PR #1245), @Ben (review + latency logging #1248), @Samir (schema review #1250), @Maya (smoke tests + metrics), @infra-bot (canary deploy). If infra-bot reports canary failure or if cost >2x baseline / p99 >300ms I'll open an incident and initiate rollback.

Carla: Noted. Posting PR links in #code-review channel as well.

Ben: added a :eyes: reaction on the main graphs.

infra-bot: canary deploy started. Monitoring: dedup-worker/canary CPU 12% -> stable, errors 0.2%.

Alice: Great — will wait for 30m window then reconvene. Thanks everyone. (reacts: :thumbsup: from Carla, :eyes: from Ben)
